subject: Is there a simple test to verify parallel processing?

messages.author: f8435c29c03ee356
messages.subject: Is there a simple test to verify parallel processing?
parts:
I'm setting up RStudio Server and RRO on the same box. This is my first foray into trying to scale R.

Is there a simple test so I can know that I set things up right and R is actually using all cores, operating in parallel, etc?

thanks

messages.author: 149440eddb848db9
messages.subject: Re: Is there a simple test to verify parallel processing?
parts:
Hi, jl

You can try the following:

# devtools::install_github("andrie/version.compare")
library(version.compare)
x <- RevoBenchmark(threads = c(1, 4), scale.factor = 0.2)
plot(x)

This install the version.compare package from github and runs a simple benchmark using first a single thread, then 4 threads.  (Change threads=c(1, 4) to your desired number of cores you want to test on.)

You should get a plot similar to this:


Regards

Andrie
